text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- State has mobilised to prepare for referendum to amend constitution on November 28.
- President Zeroual names former justice minister Hamdani Benkhelil as head of government anti-graft watchdog.
- Referendum campaign: Islamist parties lay down law while pro-democracy forces still divided.
- Iron and steel factory workers send letter to President Zeroual asking him to intervene to help salvage their jobs.
- Algeria takes part in developing countries' meeting in Harare intended to increase trade and defend their interests.
